verifiedAgainst.note: Verified with a caveat worth reading before using this target. Custom commands have been MERGED INTO SKILLS: the docs state that `.claude/commands/deploy.md` and `.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md` both create `/deploy` and work the same way, that existing `.claude/commands/` files keep working and support the same front matter, and that skills are now recommended because they also support supporting files. Where a skill and a command share a name, the skill wins. This profile is therefore a live but superseded convention — prefer claude-skills. Kept first-class because ADR-0013 named it and because the path still works, not because it is the current recommendation.

vendorFields.partitionNote: One command per role that carries command units. The `condition` on the output means a role with no commands emits no file rather than an empty one — a slash command with no steps is worse than a missing one.
